title: Number of Islands
description:
Given an `m x n` grid of characters where `"1"` is land and `"0"` is water, return the **number of islands**.

An island is a group of land cells connected horizontally or vertically. You may assume everything outside the grid is water.
hints: Scan every cell. When you find unvisited land, count one island and flood-fill it so you never count it again.
You can flood-fill with DFS, BFS or union-find.
